message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards applied to the extracted sentences or any other incoming data before it is used.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local filesystem paths only; no remote fetching is performed and no checksum or integrity verification is present.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label distributions, checking of label values against an expected set, or use of any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab anywhere in the code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline performs sentence extraction, vectorization, and random sampling but applies no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained word vectors and vectorizer saves are loaded from disk paths (e.g., 'saves/word2vec.save', 'saves/onehot.save') and embedding weights are loaded via nn.Embedding.from_pretrained without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.
No detected label distribution validation: No code inspects class frequencies, checks for imbalance, or validates the expected label set before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense mechanism.
No detected differential privacy: There is no import or use of Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any differential-privacy mechanism anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD attack implementations are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is performed, there is no cryptographic signing or hashing of evaluation data, no isolation guarantees enforced programmatically, and only a single loss/accuracy metric is tracked without independent verification.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation are performed on incoming data before it is passed to the model during inference.
No detected output bounds checks: The model outputs log_softmax values but no code checks for NaN, out-of-range probabilities, or calibrated thresholds before returning predictions.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model processes text sequences, it is a next-word prediction RNN/LSTM/GRU, not an LLM, and no prompt-injection filtering or output content moderation is implemented.
